content: Another great night of JAMMIN’ Trivia, as the small crowd new to the game got into it over the course of the evening. No technical difficulties after figuring out the less-than-easy video setup. The hook-in is really far from the bar, extensions would be helpful. ======================= As Steven said, the vibe was great but the crowd was paltry. The sound system definitely helps in that place. I do think increasing awareness of the event would help, there were 2 teams (I think) that were there last time, so the potential is there. Because of the layout in the bar, IT WOULD BE HELPFUL TO HAVE EXTENSIONS for audio and video in order to place the DJ Booth closer to the crowd, as the access to the system is pretty far removed from where the Trivia players are located, and they have to walk sometimes over 50 feet to submit their answers.

content: Had an awesome time tonight with Matt DiAno leading the way. We had some challenges technically going to a new place, but got through them and were Jammin’ through a raging sound system – it sounded great. The place was pretty big, can probably max out with 3-400 people but there were only 30 or less. This was no matter, as Matt wound things up for about 8 teams and got everybody into it. I took over for a while , calling round 2 and felt better than ever about my performance. I was able to maintain the connection with the teams to keep things going, then turned it back over to Matt to finish up. During this time I made my way around the place and encouraged everybody to keep playing and reminded them of the prizes. I was a great night, Matt was awesome to work with.

title: The Rusty Bucket 04/12/2012
excerpt: Great night at Fun City for JAMMIN’ Trivia! Started out and peaked with 4 teams. Finished with 3 teams. Congratulations to Team The Moms for winning tonight! After finding out that we do JAMMIN’ Trivia at Fun City every Thursday a few people said they would return.
